index.title: Organize Email Inbox for Recurring Expenses
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Organize Email. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Organize Email Inbox for Recurring Expenses. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help, not
index.what_happened_excerpt: A person set up a bot to manage their email inbox, specifically for organizing recurring expenses and subscriptions. The bot helped them keep track of merchant emails, receipts, and billing information, and reported on unknown bills daily.
index.bot_name: Find the spend first, let another bot go kill it
